output.reason: The brief ties the drop to the 14 April credit-limit change, and the figures back that up: referrals jumped, and when you weight referred and non-referred calls by their fixed resolution rates you get roughly the observed fall. Tenured and new agents fell by the same amount, which rules out the new starters, and the IVR timing rules out the menu redesign. It also gives a clear, low-risk two-team trial, though workload was not tested.
